reason: The help text under the disabled Recipient gets field, "If you would like to adjust the amount, please cancel and create a new payment.", measures 2.68:1 at 12px, where AA needs 4.5:1. It is a standalone instruction that explains the locked amount, not the label or value of the disabled control, so the inactive-component exception does not cover it. The editing task stays possible, so it stays medium.

The Repeat count unit combobox (week, month) has autocomplete="garbage", which axe reads as an invalid token. The field collects no information about the user and has no WCAG input purpose, so the token hides nothing from any user and 1.3.5 does not fail.
criterionAnalysis: 1.3.5 applies only to input fields that collect information about the user and serve one of the input purposes WCAG lists, such as name, email or street address. The Repeat count unit combobox (week, month) is not one of them, so there is no purpose to identify and no token to get wrong. The value autocomplete="garbage" is a deliberate autofill opt-out, set with the data-1p-ignore, data-lpignore and data-bwignore attributes where the field has them, and browsers treat an unknown token as no purpose. 4.1.2 is not affected: the accessibility tree gives the field its name, role and state. No other A or AA criterion covers the attribute.
